reason: Recharge the cold packs so the transfer reserve is ready again; the powered freezer is the natural place to do that.
expectation: The freezer should restore the packs' ability to absorb heat during a future transfer.

alternatives.reason: Restarting the propellant plant also addresses a stated goal, but I want to restore the cold reserve first.

effect: The flight packs are reconditioned and the cold-transfer reserve goal is complete; I can now restart production.
reaction: A straightforward and reassuring result, though the action was predictable.
reason: The remaining goal is to restart propellant production, and supplying the restart controls is the only gameplay option.
expectation: The solar supply will restart the plant and begin replacing lost propellant, though I don't know whether there will be further steps.

effect: The return plant is running and both reserve goals are complete; no further action is needed in this chapter.
reaction: It is satisfying to restore the plant, but the result gives little detail about the restart.

mostWorthwhile.text: Reconditioning the cold packs was worthwhile because it reconnects the reserve to protecting the discovery during transfer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Restarting the plant was a single obvious control action with a terse result; I wanted to see more of how production resumed.

surprise.text: Neither result surprised me; both matched the stated goals.

arbitrary.text: Neither action felt arbitrary: the freezer recharges the packs and the solar supply powers the restart.

continue.text: Yes, I would continue to find out what happens to the body in the ice and its journey home, although these two routine actions alone were not especially engaging.
